description: Second slice. Add a durable StructFieldExpectation/StructReference obligation store mirroring InterfaceExpectation/InterfaceRequester{code,module,span}, validated on StructDefined settle at requester spans. Migrate resolve.rs TypeExpr::StructRecord to record A.field obligations and wait/read StructDefined(A) when precise schema/order is needed -- it must NOT silently drop unknown fields (current bug). Test (ticket #3): type-expression @type t :: %A{field: integer} records A.field, waits/reads StructDefined(A), unknown fields diagnosed not dropped. Needs the StructDef store from the first slice.

comments.text: Folded at aab61dde6 (world.rs doc-comment conflict with .12 resolved: merged to name all three now-migrated consumers). Obligation store mirrors InterfaceExpectation (StructFieldExpectation + validate-on-settle, bidirectional: publish-side + note-side); resolve.rs TypeExpr::StructRecord reads the durable struct_def_fields; a single publish-time record_function_type_refs walk covers @type/@spec/guard/extern. THREE adversarial-audit rounds, each fixing a real reproduced gap before fold: (1) @spec/guard shared the StructRecord arm but weren't wired -> still silently dropped; fixed via the shared publish-time walk + StructDefined waits in derive_function_contract/plan_entry_dispatch. (2) non-struct %A{} (plain module / typo) waited on a StructDefined that never publishes -> bounded stall with ZERO diagnostics (unresolved_issue had no arm); fixed via RESOLVE_NOT_A_STRUCT + unresolved_struct_issue (settled-without-defstruct -> diagnose at requester span; wholly-unresolved -> defer to module-not-defined, no double-report). (3) extern contracts DO name user structs; lower_function waited only on TypeDefined -> extern %Point{} resolved literal-order (silently wrong); fixed via a StructDefined wait in lower_function's extern spec-resolution wait-set (did NOT touch .11's MakeStruct/StructField). drive.rs also gained the StructDefined->DefineModule producer mapping (first real waiter). Tests: precise-order @type, unknown-field @type (both dirs), unknown-field @spec, non-struct @spec diagnostic, extern wait, guard-annotation unknown-field -- all non-vacuous (verified by /tmp-copy revert, no git stash). Verified: lib 1262/0/6, composed-branch matrix 350/11 (no new red), clippy+fmt clean. Follow-ups: fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.2 (per-consumer wait-set split, benign over-wait), fz-b6w (obligation-store retraction). Unblocked .11 and .13.

title: Structs: obligation store + validate-on-settle; migrate resolve.rs TypeExpr::StructRecord
